title: feat(automation,approvals): hand every run its root run and record run, and record both on each approval request
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRHV6v1af1FotHhUucFikMF)_

Part of #37766 — slice A ("The root run") only, plus the seat's ruling that each request also records the run that carries its record. Slices B, C and D stay on the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：自动化引擎给每一次流程运行（含子流程、逐条审批的子运行）记下它所属的「根运行」和「承载这条记录的运行」，每张审批请求打开时把两者记进自己的三列；旧运行在恢复时补上。
- 这是「单据关闭锁」专题（ADR-0162 第 7 项）的第一片：后面的「打开时检查」和「撤回不写关闭值」都要靠它判断哪些请求属于同一次审批、同一条记录。
- 审批行为不变：发版前就停在子流程里、而上层运行已经不在的审批，下一步照常打开，只是这三列留空；可整体回滚。
- 无。

## What changes

ADR-0162 Execution item 7, "The root run". A child run (a `subflow` body or a `map` item) knew only its immediate parent (`$parentRunId`), and a request's stamps live in its config snapshot, which the store cannot filter on.

**`@objectstack/service-automation`**
- `root-run.ts` (new): the `RootRun` shape `{ runId, flowName, object, startedAt }` on context key `$rootRun`, the `RecordRun` shape `{ runId, object, recordId }` on `$recordRun`, `stampRootRun`, `readRootRun`, `readRecordRun` and `deriveRunLinks`.
- Every run's own context is stamped at start, in `execute()` (`engine.ts`) and in each retry attempt (`dag-traversal.ts#executeWithoutRetry`).
  - **Root run.** A run with no parent is its own root, whatever root the caller's context carried. A child keeps the root it inherited from its parent's context (the `subflow` and `map` nodes build the child's context from the parent's, and the stamp rides every suspension, JSON included). `object` is the object the root run was started on (its context's `object`, with or without a record), never a `map` item's own `itemObject`; `null` when the root names none.
  - **Record run** (seat ruling). The highest run, from this run up, over which the record `(object, record.id)` does not change: the root run, or a `map` item run whose item is a record. A `subflow` child, and a `map` item that is not a record, inherit their parent's record and so its record run.
- `AutomationEngine.rootRunOf(context)` and `recordRunOf(context)` answer them, as `flowKeyOfRun` answers the slot key. `RootRun` and `RecordRun` are exported as types.
- A run parked before this release carries neither. `run-resume.ts#resumeInternal` derives both when the run is resumed, in one walk of the run's `$parentRunId` links through the strict suspended-run loader, before the advance claim, on a copy of the segment context (the persisted context is untouched, as for the decider segment). Three outcomes:
  - derived (from the top of the chain, or from the first parent that already carries a root run);
  - a parent the store cannot read: the resume is refused with `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` and nothing is consumed, so the identical resume can be retried;
  - a parent that is no longer parked (or a chain over 32 links): the run is stamped `null` on both, logged once at `warn`, and goes on.
- A key present with the value `null` means "stamped, could not be placed": it is not walked again on every resume, and a child such a run starts inherits the `null` (a child is never mistaken for a root).

**`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`**
- The approval node reads `rootRunOf` and `recordRunOf` off the automation surface and passes `rootRun` and `recordRun` to `openNodeRequest` (new optional inputs, types `ApprovalRootRun` and `ApprovalRecordRun`, mirrored because the plugin does not depend on service-automation, and exported from the plugin's index beside `ApprovalNodeAutoOutcome`).
- `sys_approval_request` gains `root_run_id` (text), `root_run_started_at` (datetime) and `record_run_id` (text), all read-only, written at open and never re-derived; the two ids join the free-text search set beside `flow_run_id`; indexes `(root_run_id, object_name, record_id)` and `(record_run_id)`. Translation bundles regenerated; the three labels and helps are translated in all ten non-default locales.
- A run the engine could not place (stamped `null` above) opens its approval step exactly as before, with the three columns empty, the same as on an automation surface without `rootRunOf`. ADR-0162's later checks treat such a request as one that records no root run (slice B: not judged at open; slice C: down the order at abandonment). Nothing the node accepts narrows.

## Why

Slice B's open-time check and slice C's abandonment probe both have to ask "which requests belong to this one whole approval, and to this one record of it". The engine knows the answer at every depth; the plugin's reader of a run does not answer a run's context. Recording it on the request, in columns the store can filter, is what lets them ask.

### Small calls made in this PR (dev-thread latitude; the seat may overrule)

1. **Root run: two columns.** The id answers slice B's open-time probe and slice C's abandonment probe by root run. Slice C also asks "was a request that records no root run opened since the approval's run started", at abandonment, where the run's context is no longer in hand, so the root's start is recorded too. The root's flow and object are not stored: slice B reads them at open, where the node hands them.
2. **Record run: "the record does not change" means the same `(object, record.id)` pair**, compared the way the `map` node hands an item (`object` plus `record.id`, a numeric id read as its string). A `map` item that is not a record (no string or numeric id) has no record of its own, so it inherits its parent's record run. The opening run itself stays in `flow_run_id` and is not repeated.
3. **What a failed derivation does** (revised per the L2 must-fix M1 and the seat's ruling on #37766). A parent the store cannot read refuses the resume (retryable, nothing consumed). A parent that is gone stamps the run `null`, said once at `warn`, and the run goes on; its approval steps open with the three columns empty, as on an engine that hands no root run. Only runs parked before this release can reach either arm.
4. **Semver.** `Metadata-protocol: none` (no authorable key moves), so both packages ship `patch` per AGENTS.md's post-task rule 3, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` for the two new engine members, the two context keys, the two service inputs and the three columns. The automation-service change carries its own changeset line.
5. **The root's flow member is the slot key** (`SuspendedRun.flowName`), the key the engine files the root's flow under, which is what slice B needs to read the flow back.
6. **A stale `$rootRun` / `$recordRun` on a top-level caller's context is overwritten**, never trusted: only `$parentRunId` makes a run a child.

### Review rounds

- L2 contract review 7210688247 (FAIL at `6039ced1`): M1 fixed in `39602028` (the approval step of an unplaced run opens with the three columns empty; the broken-tree pin inverted and ablated). N1 (the two interfaces moved above `ApprovalNodeAutoOutcome`'s doc), N2 (the stranded test comment moved to `PARENT`), N3 (the `object` docs now say what the stamp reads: the context's `object`, with or without a record id) and N5 (`ApprovalRootRun` / `ApprovalRecordRun` exported from the plugin's index) fixed in the same commit. N4: one changeset file kept, per the seat. S1: the seat posted the `record_run_id` ruling and its three pins on #37766 (7210700837).

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/root-run.test.ts` (20):
  - root run: own root with id, flow, object and start, before and after a pause; a stale caller root overwritten; record-less root `object: null`; each retry attempt its own root; a `subflow` child two levels down; two `map` items side by side, with the parent's object;
  - pre-change runs: a child derived on an engine that did not park it; a root derives itself; a child a resumed pre-change parent starts inherits the derived root and parks with it; a broken chain stamps `null` with one `warn` and the run completes; an unreadable parent refuses with `STORE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing consumed, and a retry continues;
  - record run (the seat's three shapes and their edges): the root run is its own; a `subflow` child inherits its parent's; a `map` item that is a record is its own, under the parent's root; a `map` item that is not a record inherits its parent's; a `subflow` under a record item inherits the item run; the same three derived for pre-change runs; a child started under an unstamped, unreadable parent is stamped `null` on both and not walked.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/request-root-run.integration.test.ts` (6, real SQLite through `SqlDriver`, the plugin's own objects synced, real engine): a root run's request records its own run as root and record run, and the store answers by `root_run_id`; a `subflow` child's two requests record the parent for both; **the card's test**: a child run started before the release (played as a restart over the same store with both stamps removed from the parked runs and the columns from the first request) opens its second request after it, and that request records the parent's id, start and record run; a batch `map` over records: each request records the batch as root and its item run as record run, and the store answers by `record_run_id` with that item's requests only; a child whose tree cannot be read whole still opens its second step, and that request records no root run or record run (the run is not failed); a surface without `rootRunOf` records none.

<details><summary>Ablation — every tested behaviour, red without the change, restored and proved</summary>

Each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, restore proved by blob hash) and `git diff HEAD` empty after it. Engine legs E1–E6, R1–R3, R5 run at `ef16f2e6` (R1 re-run with a non-overlapping replacement after its first anchor declaration was refused); since then the engine source changed only in one log string and doc comments. Plugin legs P1–P3 and R4 re-run at `39602028`, after the M1 fix.

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| E1 | delete the stamp in `execute()` | 19 of 20 engine pins |
| E2 | delete the stamp in `executeWithoutRetry` | 1 (the retry pin) |
| E3 | skip the derivation in `resumeInternal` | 8 (the pre-change pins) |
| E4 | let a top-level run keep an incoming root | 1 (the stale-root pin) |
| E5 | derive through the degrading loader | 1 (the unreadable-parent pin) |
| E6 | stamp a child's root with its own id | 4 (two levels, two `map` items, record `map` item, inherited-derived) |
| R1 | a child inherits its parent's record run whatever its record | 2 (record `map` item, `subflow` under it) |
| R2 | a child is always its own record run | 3 (`subflow` inherits, non-record item, `subflow` under a record item) |
| R3 | the derivation never moves the record run below the top | 2 (pre-change `map` item and `subflow` under it) |
| R5 | re-derive a `null` stamp on every resume | 1 (the `null`, not-walked pin) |
| P1 | write `root_run_id: null` | 4 of 6 integration pins |
| R4 | write `record_run_id: null` | 4 of 6 integration pins |
| P2 | refuse the step when the engine hands rootRunOf and has none for the run (the pre-M1 behaviour) | 1 (the broken-tree pin: the step opens, columns empty) |
| P3 | record a made-up root run where the engine has none | 2 (the broken-tree pin and the older-engine pin) |
| E3 via `dist/` | E3 rebuilt into `service-automation/dist` (`ablation-dist-preflight` marker present), then the plugin suite | the card's test (1 of 6), run at `6039ced1`; restore rebuilt, marker absent, tree clean |

</details>
